## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//rst:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//rst:defs.bzl", "rst_library")
```

## Rules

### `rst_library`

Owns the reStructuredText files of one package for dx quality.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | reStructuredText files of this package. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | reStructuredText libraries this package depends on. |
| `_rst2html` | `label` | no |  |
